description.value: The Pink Geranium is a market, café, and e-bike rental hub at the north end of Galiano Island, reopened in 2021 in a historic building that first housed a beloved island restaurant founded in 1972. The café serves espresso drinks, breakfast and lunch sandwiches, baked goods, and pantry items, making it a natural provisioning stop for cyclists on the island. It also operates as the island's designated e-bike rental point and check-in location for the Bodega Ridge resort properties.

address.value: 18585 Porlier Pass Rd, Galiano Island, BC V0N 1P0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at https://www.pinkgeranium.com/ confirms an active café, market, and e-bike rental business at 18585 Porlier Pass Rd, Galiano Island, BC — contradicting the OSM community field which lists 'Chemainus'; the OSM coordinates (48.9671977, -123.5538749) are geographically consistent with Galiano Island, not Chemainus.
